notes.title: BitVault v1.0.2 - Unlimited Undo
notes.content:
Hello hackers!

Today, we have released BitVault version 1.0.2. This update mostly includes quality of life fixes and improvements. However, there is one brand new feature you will love!

- Previously, you were limited to undoing a maximum of 3 moves.
- Now, you can undo an unlimited numbers moves. 

Hopefully, this will be a valuable tool in helping optimize the way you can solve the toughest puzzles in BitVault.

Happy hacking!

notes.title: Countdown To Release!
notes.content:
All of us at Enigma Dragons are very excited for BitVault's launch! In less than 9 hours, you will begin your journey to become expert hackers as you learn to navigate corporate politics and hack increasingly difficult devices.

We're very excited to see al of you put your brains to good work and solve these mind-wracking puzzles.

Happy hacking!

notes.title: BitVault Gone Gold!
notes.content:
This past weekend, our development team worked hard to implement all the final content and updates from the beta testing period. 

The build is now complete and has been submitted to Steam for review. Once it's approved by Steam, we will be able to offer a firm release date. Presently, we're still looking on track to release later this month.

Happy hacking!

notes.title: BitVault Entering Final Beta Testing Period
notes.content:
BitVault is entering its final wave of Beta Testing.

The Closed Beta for BitVault began on February 15 and has yielded valuable Development insight and increased the polish level for the User Interface and killing a few elusive bugs.

The development team is hard at work integrating with Steam Cloud Saves and Steam Achievements in the final weeks before the game is launched.

If you want access to the closed beta, there is still time and a few more slots available. You will gain access to a special story and unique levels that are only present in the beta. Visit: bitvaultgame.com for more details.

Right now everything is looking on track for a release in late March.

Happy hacking!
